definitions.gloss: to recommend; to endorse; to advocate
definitions.explanation: To formally recommend something as good or suitable. More formal than すすめる, often used in official or institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}が{推奨|すいしょう}する。
この{方法|ほうほう}はメーカーが{推奨|すいしょう}している。
examples.english: This method is recommended by the manufacturer.

examples.japanese: {厚生労働省|こうせいろうどうしょう}は{一日|いちにち}{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}の{運動|うんどう}を{推奨|すいしょう}している。
examples.english: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare recommends 30 minutes of exercise per day.

notes: More formal and official than {勧|すす}める (to recommend). Frequently used in product specifications, government guidelines, and academic writing. The noun form {推奨|すいしょう} often appears as a modifier: {推奨|すいしょう}{環境|かんきょう} (recommended system requirements), {推奨|すいしょう}{量|りょう} (recommended amount). Related: {非推奨|ひすいしょう} (deprecated, not recommended).
